source_claim: The official My-Otome / Garderobe site groups and names the campaign characters by school/class, including Coral Otome, Pearl Otome, Garderobe, Airies, and Other characters. Sunrise's official work page confirms My-Otome as the underlying 26-episode TV series and names/credits the core cast.
notes: The official My-Otome / Garderobe character index groups and names Arika Yumemiya, Nina Wang, and Erstin Ho among Coral Otome; Akane Soir, Chie Hallard, Shiho Huit, and Juliet Nao Zhang among Pearl Otome; Natsuki Kruger and Shizuru Viola among Garderobe staff; Haruka Armitage under Airies; Mashiro Blan de Windbloom under Windbloom; and Lena Sayers under Other: https://www.my-zhime.net/tv/character/. Its official staff/cast page also lists the cast including Arika, Nina, Mashiro, Natsuki, Shizuru, Erstin, Tomoe, Akane, Chie, Juliet, and Shiho: https://www.my-zhime.net/tv/staffcast/. Sunrise's official catalog confirms My-Otome (舞-乙HiME) as the 26-episode series and identifies Sunrise as planner/producer: https://www.sunrise-world.net/titles/pickup_165.php. This is the exact My-Otome work, not the distinct My-HiME predecessor, even where the project shares a character star system.
